common.invalidFormat: Use the format shown below the field.

register.title: Create an account
register.name: Name
register.sent: If the address can be used, we sent a link to set your password. Open it to finish creating the account.
register.sentPending: Your request was received. An administrator will review it and you will get an e-mail once it has been decided.

mfa.title: Verification
mfa.code: Code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code
mfa.passkeyOnly: Confirm it is you with the passkey of your account.

passwordChange.title: Choose a new password
passwordChange.notice: You are signing in with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.sent: If the address is registered, we sent a link to reset the password. It works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.invalid: This link is not valid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
reset.done: Your password was changed and you were signed out everywhere.

account.title: Multi-factor authentication
account.forced: It is required for your account and cannot be turned off.
account.scan: Scan the QR code using your authenticator app.
account.codesText: Multi-factor authentication is on. Keep these recovery codes in a safe place: each works once, and they are not shown again.
account.changeConfirm: Your current authenticator stops working now, and you set up a new one next. Until you finish, your account is protected by the password only.
account.disableConfirm: Turn off multi-factor authentication? Your account will be protected by the password only, and the recovery codes are deleted.
account.reauth: Confirm it is you: enter your password and a code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).
account.cantScan: Can't scan the QR code? Show setup key
account.verifyText: Enter the 6 digit code your authenticator app shows.
account.savedCheck: I have saved my recovery codes

code.csrf_expired: The form expired. Please try again.
code.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
code.invalid_code: Wrong code. Check the clock of your device and try again.
code.challenge_expired: Too many wrong attempts or the request expired. Please sign in again.
code.invalid_link: This link is not valid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
code.mfa_forced: Multi-factor authentication is required for your account.
code.password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
code.password_too_short: The password must have at least 12 characters.
code.password_same: The password must differ from the previous one.
code.password_email: The password must not contain the e-mail address.
code.invalid_passkey: The passkey was not accepted. Try again or use another way to sign in.
code.invalid_passkey_name: The name must have 1 to 60 characters.
code.passkey_limit: You have reached the maximum number of passkeys.
code.passkey_failed: The passkey could not be used. Try again or use your password.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Please try again.

page.bad_redirect: The redirect address is not registered for this application.
page.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.done: Your password is set. You can now sign in with it.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password. A passkey also counts as the second factor.
passkeys.name: Name of the passkey
passkeys.limit: You have the maximum of {{max}} passkeys.
passkeys.addText: Give the passkey a name you will recognize, for example the device it lives on.
passkeys.addPasswordText: Enter your password to add it. Your device then asks you to confirm.
passkeys.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? You will no longer be able to sign in with it.
